facts.fact: As children Neela and Ammu saw Vellan's bear-shape stand over them in the Resin House yard, and they have seen other girls taken to the kennels as punishment. Neela already knows members are caged.
Chinna's kitchen-door gossip reached Ammu: the bride was seen at the window at dawn in her sleeping cloth.
Neela's nails begin to itch at the quick on day sixteen, a warning before the ache. Ammu has waited about three weeks at the inn.
Ammu carries a twist of paper with Chathu's message and keeps it; it is never handed to Neela.
